استدفأت (form X)

# اِسْتَدْفَأْتَ (istadfaʔta) /is.tad.faʔ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَدْفَأَ (istadfaʔa)
# اِسْتَدْفَأْتِ (istadfaʔti) /is.tad.faʔ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَدْفَأَ (istadfaʔa)
# اِسْتَدْفَأَتْ (istadfaʔat) /is.t
